title: Noor and the Verdict
author: Orsen Blackwood
blurb: Elodie Fairweather, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
